text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute and I are taking a walk
through
the park, when...

Doth my eyes deceive me? If it isn't
Acute!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Out for a stroll as well, Opera O? Nice
weather
we're having, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We bump into T.M. Opera O and
exchange a few
words. And then...

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text: Oh, heeeyyy!

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text:
I've seen you two before! You're always
running
around and stuff, right?!

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: It's called racing! Geez... Sorry about him!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A small boy and girl of similar stature
suddenly
run up to us. Their faces are
remarkably similar as
well, so I suspect
they're twins.

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text:
We love watching your races! It's so cool
meeting
you like this!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oho! It seems even the youngest of
spectators are
engrossed by the
Overlord's dazzling aura!

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, let's play together! I wanna play

hide-and-go-seek! I bet you'll never find
me!

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text:
No fair! I want to play in the sandbox!
Let's build
a big sandcastle!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Goodness me. It seems they're at odds.

What shall we do, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It breaks my heart knowing I'll have to
disappoint
one of these bright-eyed
kids, but for now, we'll
start with...

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaay! I win! Hehe! You'll never find
me!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well then, why don't I be "it" first? Go
and hide,
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... Let me see... The inside of that
slide
seems awful suspicious...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whooosh!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Is anyone in here?

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh! She's gonna find me! But you
can't catch
me that easily!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It seems that I, too, am in danger of
being
spotted. Time for a tactical
retreat!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hm? I know I heard voices just now...
Perhaps
they ran off towards that tree.

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text:
Gyah! She's fast! But I'll get away, just
you watch!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah ha ha! The speed of a worthy
adversary! Now,
to relocate!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Huh. I could have sworn they were over
here,
but there's no trace of them.

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text:
Hey... She's fast, but she's plain bad at
being "it."

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Is that truly the case? Have you not considered the possibility that your skills are simply that magnificent?

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I guess you're right! Hehe! There's no
way
she'll catch me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The little boy deftly evades Wonder
Acute's swift
pursuit time and again.
Their game of cat and
mouse continues
on until finally...

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text: Aw, yeah! Time's up! We win!

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text: See? Told you I was good at hiding!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That you are. I could hear your voice,
but I
couldn't manage to catch you.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! You fought bravely, young warriors!
It is an
honor to be considered among
your number!

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! That was so much fun! Let's play
again
sometime!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I'll be sure to practice for
next time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems this was a good experience for
Wonder
Acute, who is practically
skipping as we return
home.

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Okay, let's make teams! Whoever
builds the
biggest castle wins!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the girl teams up with Wonder
Acute, and
the boy joins T.M. Opera O.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Scoosh, scruff, scritch...

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text:
C'mon! We've got to make our castle
even bigger!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Right you are, my lad! A castle built by
the
Overlord must reach into the
heavens!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Shovel, shovel, pat, pat...

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text:
I don't just want it to be big. I want it to
be pretty
too. So we need to be really
careful.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I know just what you mean, dear.
We'll start
with a strong foundation.

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeaaaah! Look how tall it is! But we
can still
go hi—uwah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crumble... Voosh!

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text: NOOO! Our castle!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no... It collapsed... But it's okay. We
can all
work together to finish this
castle.

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text:
...What do you think? Are we ready to
make the
roof now?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hm, almost. Just let me make the base a
smidge
stronger first.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The more decorations we add, the
heavier the
roof will be. The base needs
to be strong enough
to support it.

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: Right! I get it! Just a smiiidge stronger!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Beauty is always backed by
strength. That is
as true in sand castle
construction as it is in life.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everyone takes their time and carefully
constructs
a sand castle under Wonder
Acute's guidance.

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text:
It's all finished! Wonder Castle is
complete! ♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
What's this? You're naming the castle
after me?

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text:
Yep! If you hadn't given us all those tips,
then we
never could have made such a
big castle!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. We have your steady hand and
guidance
to thank.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'm glad that you're so happy with
it. Let's
build an even bigger one next
time.
